item_name: Medical Evaluation Does Not Meet Requirements
lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND. The protocol's Area 6 states timing requirements tied to the physical examination date (medical evaluation must be completed within 30 days from the examination date; for newly admitted residents the physical examination must occur within 30 days of the admission date), but it does not state an assessor observation/look-back window ending on an assessment reference date for this item. The document header also states the protocol applies to service dates 01/01/2013 through 10/31/2025, which is a scope period, not a look-back window.

state_deltas.delta: OMIG (New York) audit criteria for Area 6: medical evaluation must be dated within 30 days of the physical examination, the exam must occur within 30 days of admission for newly admitted residents, and the evaluation must be dated and signed by an authorized practitioner; failure results in claim disallowance.

case_mix_relevance.notes: Area 6 states that non-conforming medical evaluations result in claim disallowance, but the document does not tie this item to a case-mix/payment classification (e.g., RUG group). RUG-related requirements appear under separate audit areas (12 and 13), not Area 6.
